name: Shield Master
summary: +1 Str; bash foes with your Shield to push them or knock them Prone, and block area damage with it.

benefits.name: Shield Bash
benefits.summary: Once per turn after a melee weapon hit, Shield bash: Str save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or pushed 5 ft or Prone.
benefits.text: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit it with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash it with your equipped Shield. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or, your choice, be pushed 5 feet away from you or gain the Prone condition. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

benefits.name: Interpose Shield
benefits.summary: Reaction while holding a Shield: take no damage on a successful Dex save against a half-damage effect.
benefits.text: If an effect lets you make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage and you are holding a Shield, you can take a Reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw.
